'''Zosh Vexonuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was a member of the [[Blood Raptors]] gang and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he represented the Raptors in the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]], flying a [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] [[JR-4 swoop/Legends|JR-4 swoop]].
